paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 26 to 35 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 26 至 35 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: After becoming president of Purdue University in 2013, Mitch Daniels asked the faculty to prove that their students have actually achieved one of higher education's most important goals: critical thinking skills. Two years before, a nationwide study of college graduates had shown that more than a third had made no __26__ gains in such mental abilities during their school years. Mr. Daniels needed to __27__ the high cost of attending Purdue to its students and their families. After all, the percentage of Americans who say a college degree is "very important" has fallen __28__ in the last 5-6 years.
paragraphs.translationZh: 2013 年成为普渡大学校长后，米奇·丹尼尔斯 (Mitch Daniels) 要求教师们证明他们的学生实际上已经实现了高等教育最重要的目标之一：批判性思维能力。两年前，一项针对大学毕业生的全国性研究表明，超过三分之一的人在上学期间在这种心理能力方面没有取得显着的进步。丹尼尔斯先生需要向学生及其家人证明就读普渡大学的高昂费用是合理的。毕竟，认为大学学位“非常重要”的美国人比例在过去 5-6 年里急剧下降。

paragraphs.sourceText: Purdue now has a pilot test to assess students' critical thinking skills. Yet like many college teachers around the U.S., the faculty remain __29__ that their work as educators can be measured by a "learning __30__" such as a graduate's ability to investigate and reason. However, the professors need not worry so much. The results of a recent experiment showed that professors can use __31__ metrics to measure how well students do in three key areas: critical thinking, written communication, and quantitative literacy. 第4 页共10 页
paragraphs.translationZh: 普渡大学现在进行了一项试点测试，以评估学生的批判性思维能力。然而，与美国许多大学教师一样，教师们仍然怀疑他们作为教育工作者的工作是否可以通过“学习成果”来衡量，例如毕业生的调查和推理能力。不过，教授们不必太担心。最近的一项实验结果表明，教授可以使用标准化指标来衡量学生在三个关键领域的表现：批判性思维、书面交流和定量读写能力。

paragraphs.sourceText: Despite the success of the experiment, the actual results are worrisome, and mostly __32__ earlier studies. The organizers of the experiment concluded that far fewer students were achieving at high levels on critical thinking than they were doing for written communication or quantitative literacy. And that conclusion is based only on students nearing graduation.
paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管实验取得了成功，但实际结果令人担忧，并且大多证实了早期的研究。实验组织者得出的结论是，在批判性思维方面取得高水平的学生远少于在书面交流或定量读写方面取得高水平的学生。这个结论仅基于即将毕业的学生。

paragraphs.sourceText: American universities, despite their global __33__ for excellence in teaching, have only begun to demonstrate what they can produce in real-world learning. Knowledge-based degrees are still important, but employers are __34__ advanced thinking skills from college graduates. If the intellectual worth of a college degree can be __35__ measured, more people will seek higher education—and come out better thinkers.
paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管美国大学在教学方面享有盛誉，但它们才刚刚开始展示它们在现实世界学习中的能力。以知识为基础的学位仍然很重要，但雇主要求大学毕业生具备先进的思维能力。如果大学学位的智力价值能够得到准确衡量，就会有更多的人寻求高等教育，并成为更好的思想家。

paragraphs.sourceText: Directions:In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.
paragraphs.translationZh: 说明：在本节中，您将阅读一段附有十个陈述的段落。每条陈述都包含其中一个段落中给出的信息。确定信息来源的段落。您可以多次选择一个段落。每个段落都标有一个字母。通过在答题卡 2 上标记相应的字母来回答问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Price of Oil and the Price of Carbon
paragraphs.translationZh: 石油价格和碳价格

paragraphs.sourceText: A. Fossil fuel prices are likely to stay "low for long". Notwithstanding important recent progress in developing rene wable fuel sources, low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy tech nologies. The result would be higher emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
paragraphs.translationZh: 答：化石燃料价格可能会“长期保持在低位”。尽管最近在开发可再生燃料方面取得了重要进展，但较低的化石燃料价格可能会阻碍清洁能源技术的进一步创新和采用。结果将是二氧化碳和其他温室气体的排放量增加。

paragraphs.sourceText: B. Policymakers should not allow low energy prices to derail the clean energy transition. Action to restore appropri ate price incentives, notably through corrective carbon pricing, is urgently needed to lower the risk of irreversible an d potentially devastating effects of climate change. That approach also offers fiscal benefits.
paragraphs.translationZh: B. 政策制定者不应允许低能源价格破坏清洁能源转型。迫切需要采取行动恢复适当的价格激励措施，特别是通过纠正碳定价，以降低气候变化造成不可逆转和潜在破坏性影响的风险。这种方法还可以带来财政效益。

paragraphs.sourceText: C. Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014. A commonly held view in the oil industry is that "the bes t cure for low oil prices is low oil prices". The reasoning behind this saying is that low oil prices discourage investme nt in new production capacity, eventually shifting the oil supply curve backward and bringing prices back up as exist ing oil fields—which can be tapped at relatively low marginal cost—are depleted. In fact, in line with past experienc e, capital expenditure in the oil sector has dropped sharply in many producing countries, including the United State s. The dynamic adjustment to low oil prices may, however, be different this time around.
paragraphs.translationZh: C、自2014年6月以来，油价已下跌60%以上。石油行业普遍认为，“解决低油价的最好办法就是低油价”。这种说法背后的原因是，低油价阻碍了对新产能的投资，最终使石油供应曲线向后移动，并导致价格回升，因为现有油田（可以以相对较低的边际成本开采）枯竭。事实上，根据过去的经验，包括美国在内的许多产油国的石油部门资本支出已大幅下降。然而，这次针对低油价的动态调整可能会有所不同。

paragraphs.sourceText: D. Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer. The advent of new technologies has added about 4.2 millio n barrels per day to the crude oil market, contributing to a global over-supply. In addition, other factors are putting do wnward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countrie s, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging market s), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes. T hese likely persistent forces, like the growth of shale (页岩) oil, point to a "low for long" scenario. Futures market s, which show only a modest recovery of prices to around $60 a barrel by 2019, support this view. 第5 页共10 页
paragraphs.translationZh: D. 预计油价将在更长时间内保持较低水平。新技术的出现使原油市场每天增加约 420 万桶，导致全球供应过剩。此外，其他因素也给油价带来下行压力：石油输出国组织战略行为的变化、伊朗出口的预计增长、全球需求（尤其是新兴市场）的缩减、美国石油消费的长期下降以及石油替代品的部分替代。这些可能持久的力量，如页岩油的增长，预示着“长期低迷”的情况。期货市场显示，到 2019 年，价格仅小幅回升至每桶 60 美元左右，这支持了这一观点。

paragraphs.sourceText: E. Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived. Coal and na tural gas are mainly used for electricity generation, whereas oil is used mostly to power transportation, yet the price s of all these energy sources are linked. The North American shale gas boom has resulted in record low prices ther e. The recent discovery of the giant Zohr gas field off the Egyptian coast will eventually have impact on pricing in th e Mediterranean region and Europe, and there is significant development potential in many other places, notably Ar gentina. Coal prices also are low, owing to over-supply and the scaling-down of demand, especially from China, whi ch bums half of the world's coal.
paragraphs.translationZh: E. 天然气和煤炭（也是化石燃料）同样出现了价格下跌，而且这种下跌似乎是长期的。煤炭和天然气主要用于发电，而石油主要用于运输，但所有这些能源的价格都是相互联系的。北美页岩气的繁荣导致价格创下历史新低。最近在埃及海岸发现的巨型佐尔气田最终将对地中海地区和欧洲的价格产生影响，并且在许多其他地方，尤其是阿根廷，也存在巨大的开发潜力。由于供应过剩和需求减少，煤炭价格也很低，尤其是来自中国的需求，中国消耗了世界一半的煤炭。

paragraphs.sourceText: F. Technological innovations have unleashed the power of renewables such as wind, hydro, solar, and geotherma l (地热). Even Africa and the Middle East, home to economies that areheavily dependent on fossil fuel exports, hav e enormous potential to develop renewables. For example, the United Arab Emirates has endorsed an ambitious targe t to draw 24% of its primary energy consumption from renewable sources by 2021.
paragraphs.translationZh: F. 技术创新释放了风能、水力、太阳能和地热等可再生能源的力量。即使是经济严重依赖化石燃料出口的非洲和中东也拥有发展可再生能源的巨大潜力。例如，阿拉伯联合酋长国制定了一项雄心勃勃的目标，即到 2021 年将其一次能源消耗的 24% 来自可再生能源。

paragraphs.sourceText: G. Progress in the development of renewables could be fragile, however, if fossil fuel prices remain low for long. R enewables account for only a small share of global primary energy consumption, which is still dominated by fossil fu els—30% each for coal and oil, 25% for natural gas. But renewable energy will have to displace fossil fuels to a mu ch greater extent in the future to avoid unacceptable climate risks.
paragraphs.translationZh: G. 然而，如果化石燃料价格长期保持低位，可再生能源发展的进展可能会很脆弱。可再生能源仅占全球一次能源消费的一小部分，而全球一次能源消费仍以化石燃料为主——煤炭和石油各占 30%，天然气占 25%。但未来可再生能源必须在更大程度上取代化石燃料，以避免不可接受的气候风险。

paragraphs.sourceText: H. Unfortunately, the current low prices for oil, gas, and coal may provide little incentive for research to find eve n cheaper substitutes for those fuels. There is strong evidence that both innovation and adoption of cleaner technolog y are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices. The same is true for new technologies for alleviating fossil fue l emissions.
paragraphs.translationZh: H. 不幸的是，目前石油、天然气和煤炭的低价格可能无法为研究寻找更便宜的这些燃料替代品提供动力。有强有力的证据表明，化石燃料价格上涨强烈鼓励创新和采用清洁技术。减少化石燃料排放的新技术也是如此。

paragraphs.sourceText: I. The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to cle an energy sources. Unless renewables become cheap enough that substantial carbon deposits are left underground fo r a very long time, if not forever, the planet will likely be exposed to potentially catastrophic climate risks.
paragraphs.translationZh: 一、当前化石燃料价格较低的环境肯定会推迟从化石燃料到清洁能源的能源转型。除非可再生能源变得足够便宜，大量碳沉积物会在地下很长一段时间（即使不是永远）被保留，否则地球可能会面临潜在的灾难性气候风险。

paragraphs.sourceText: J. Some climate impacts may already be discernible. For example, the United Nations Children's Fund estimates tha t some 11 million children in Africa face hunger, disease, and water shortages as a result of the strongest ElNino (厄尔尼诺) weather phenomenon in decades. Many scientists believe that El Nino events, caused by warming in the Paci fic, are becoming more intense as a result of climate change.
paragraphs.translationZh: J. 一些气候影响可能已经显而易见。例如，联合国儿童基金会估计，由于数十年来最强烈的厄尔尼诺天气现象，非洲约有 1100 万儿童面临饥饿、疾病和水资源短缺。许多科学家认为，太平洋变暖引起的厄尔尼诺现象由于气候变化而变得更加严重。

paragraphs.sourceText: K. Nations from around the world have gathered in Paris for the United Nations Climate Change Conference, CO P 21, with the goal of a universal and potentially legally-binding agreement on reducing greenhouse gas emission s. We need very broad participation to fully address the global tragedy that results when countries fail to take into ac count the negative impact oftheir carbon emissions on the rest of the world. Moreover, non-participation by nations, i f sufficiently widespread, can undermine the political will of participating countries to act.
paragraphs.translationZh: K. 来自世界各地的国家齐聚巴黎，参加联合国气候变化大会（COP 21），目标是就减少温室气体排放达成一项普遍且具有潜在法律约束力的协议。我们需要非常广泛的参与，以充分解决因各国未能考虑到其碳排放对世界其他地区的负面影响而导致的全球悲剧。此外，如果国家不参与的情况足够普遍，就会削弱参与国采取行动的政治意愿。

paragraphs.sourceText: L. The nations participating at COP 21 are focusing on quantitative emissions-reduction commitments. Economic r easoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions. The reason is tha t when carbon is priced, those emissions reductions that are least costly to implement will happen first. The Internati onal Monetary Fund calculates that countries can generate substantial fiscal revenues by eliminating fossil fuel subsi dies and levying carbon charges that capture the domestic damage caused by emissions. A tax on upstream carbon so urces is one easy way to put a price on carbon emissions, although some countries may wish to use other methods, su ch as emissions trading schemes. In order to maximize global welfare, every country's carbon pricing should reflect not only the purely domestic damage from emissions, but also the damage to foreign countries.
paragraphs.translationZh: L. 参加 COP 21 的国家重点关注量化减排承诺。经济推理表明，对每个国家来说最便宜的方法是对碳排放定价。原因是，当碳定价时，那些实施成本最低的减排将首先发生。国际货币基金组织计算出，各国可以通过取消化石燃料补贴和征收碳税来产生大量财政收入，这些碳税反映了排放造成的国内损害。对上游碳源征税是对碳排放定价的一种简单方法，尽管一些国家可能希望使用其他方法，例如排放交易计划。为了实现全球福利最大化，每个国家的碳定价不仅应该反映排放造成的纯粹国内损害，还应该反映对外国的损害。

paragraphs.sourceText: M. Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social o pportunity cost of using carbon. By raising relative demand for clean energy sources, a carbon price would also hel p align the market return to clean-energy innovation with its social return, spurring the refinement of existing technol ogies and the development of new ones. And it would raise the demand for technologies such as carbon capture an d storage, spurring their further development. If not corrected by the appropriate carbon price, low fossil fuel prices a re not accurately signaling to markets the true social profitability of clean energy. While alternative estimates of th e damage from carbon emissions differ, and it's especially hard to reckon the likely costs of possible catastrophic cli mate events, most estimates suggest substantial negative effects.
paragraphs.translationZh: M. 因此，设定正确的碳价格将有效地将碳使用者支付的成本与使用碳的真实社会机会成本结合起来。通过提高对清洁能源的相对需求，碳价还将有助于使清洁能源创新的市场回报与其社会回报保持一致，从而刺激现有技术的完善和新技术的开发。这将增加对碳捕获和储存等技术的需求，刺激其进一步发展。如果不通过适当的碳价格进行纠正，低化石燃料价格就无法准确地向市场传达清洁能源真正的社会盈利能力。虽然对碳排放造成的损害的其他估计有所不同，而且特别难以计算可能发生的灾难性气候事件的可能成本，但大多数估计表明存在巨大的负面影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: N. Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitut e for a carbon price: they do only part of the job, leaving in place market incentives to over-use fossil fuels and there 第6 页共10 页 by add to the stock of atmospheric greenhouse gases without regard to the collateral (附带的) costs.
paragraphs.translationZh: N. 一些政府已经采取了对研发的直接补贴，但对碳价格来说是一个糟糕的替代品：它们只完成了部分工作，留下了过度使用化石燃料的市场激励措施，从而增加了大气温室气体的存量，而不考虑附带的成本。

paragraphs.sourceText: O. The hope is that the success of COP 21 opens the door to future international agreement on carbon prices. Agree ment on an international carbon-price floor would be a good starting point in that process. Failure to address compre hensively the problem of greenhouse gas emissions, however, exposes all generations, present and future, to incalcul able risks.
paragraphs.translationZh: O. 希望 COP 21 的成功为未来就碳价格达成国际协议打开大门。就国际碳价格下限达成协议将是这一进程的良好起点。然而，如果不能全面解决温室气体排放问题，就会使现在和未来的各代人面临不可估量的风险。

paragraphs.sourceText: 36. A number of factors are driving down the global oil prices not just for now but in the foreseeable future.
paragraphs.translationZh: 36. 不仅目前，而且在可预见的将来，许多因素正在压低全球石油价格。

paragraphs.sourceText: 37. Pricing carbon proves the most economical way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
paragraphs.translationZh: 37. 碳定价被证明是减少温室气体排放的最经济的方法。

paragraphs.sourceText: 38. It is estimated that extreme weather conditions have endangered the lives of millions of African children.
paragraphs.translationZh: 38. 据估计，极端天气条件已危及数百万非洲儿童的生命。

paragraphs.sourceText: 39. The prices of coal are low as a result of over-supply and decreasing demand.
paragraphs.translationZh: 39. 由于供应过剩和需求减少，煤炭价格较低。

paragraphs.sourceText: 40. Higher fossil fuel prices prove to be conducive to innovation and application of cleaner technology.
paragraphs.translationZh: 40. 事实证明，化石燃料价格上涨有利于清洁技术的创新和应用。

paragraphs.sourceText: 41. If fossil fuel prices remain low for a long time, it may lead to higher emissions of greenhouse gases.
paragraphs.translationZh: 41. 如果化石燃料价格长期保持低位，可能会导致温室气体排放量增加。

paragraphs.sourceText: 42. Fossil fuels remain the major source of primary energy consumption in today's world.
paragraphs.translationZh: 42. 化石燃料仍然是当今世界一次能源消费的主要来源。

paragraphs.sourceText: 43. Even major fossil exporting countries have great potential to develop renewable energies.
paragraphs.translationZh: 43. 即使是主要化石出口国也具有开发可再生能源的巨大潜力。

paragraphs.sourceText: 44. Greenhouse gas emissions, if not properly dealt with, will pose endless risks for mankind.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44. 温室气体排放如果处理不当，将为人类带来无尽的风险。

paragraphs.sourceText: 45. It is urgent for governments to increase the cost of using fossil fuels to an appropriate level to lessen the catastrop hic effects of climate change.
paragraphs.translationZh: 45. 各国政府迫切需要将化石燃料的使用成本提高到适当水平，以减轻气候变化的灾难性影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 46 至 50 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Open data sharers are still in the minority in many fields. Although many researchers broadly agree that public a ccess to raw data would accelerate science, most are reluctant to post theresults of their own labors online.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在许多领域，开放数据共享者仍然属于少数。尽管许多研究人员普遍认为公众获取原始数据将加速科学发展，但大多数研究人员不愿意在网上发布自己的劳动成果。

paragraphs.sourceText: Some communities have agreed to share online—geneticists, for example, post DNA sequences at the GenBan k repository (库) , and astronomers are accustomed to accessing images of galaxies and stars from, say, the Sloan Di gital Sky Survey, a telescope that has observed some 500 million objects—but these remain the exception, not the rul e. Historically, scientists have objected to sharing for many reasons: it is a lot of work; until recently, good database s did no t exist; grant funders were not pushing for sharing; it has been difficult to agree on standards for formattin g data; and there is no agreed way to assign credit for data.
paragraphs.translationZh: 一些社区已经同意在网上共享——例如，遗传学家在 GenBank 存储库中发布 DNA 序列，天文学家习惯于从斯隆数字巡天望远镜（已经观测到约 5 亿个物体）获取星系和恒星的图像——但这些仍然是例外，而不是规则。从历史上看，科学家们反对共享的原因有很多：工作量很大；直到最近，良好的数据库还不存在；赠款资助者并没有推动共享；很难就数据格式化标准达成一致；并且没有一致同意的方法来分配数据的信用。

paragraphs.sourceText: But the barriers are disappearing, in part because journals and funding agencies worldwide are encouraging scie ntists to make their data public. Last year, the Royal Society in London said in its report that scientists need to "shif t away from a research culture where data is viewed as a private preserve". Funding agencies note that data paid fo r with public money should be public information, and the scientific community is recognizing that data can now b e shared digitally in ways that were not possible before. To match the growing demand, services are springing up to make it easier to publish research products online and enable other researchers to discover and cite them.
paragraphs.translationZh: 但障碍正在消失，部分原因是世界各地的期刊和资助机构都鼓励科学家公开他们的数据。去年，伦敦皇家学会在其报告中表示，科学家需要“摆脱数据被视为私人保留的研究文化”。资助机构指出，用公共资金支付的数据应该是公共信息，科学界正在认识到数据现在可以以以前不可能的方式以数字方式共享。为了满足不断增长的需求，服务不断涌现，使在线发布研究产品变得更加容易，并使其他研究人员能够发现和引用它们。

paragraphs.sourceText: Although calls to share data often concentrate on the moral advantages of sharing, the practice is not purely altr uistic (利他的). Researchers who share get plenty of personal benefits, including more connections with colleagues, i mproved visibility and increased citations. The most successful sharers—those whose data are downloaded and cite d the most often---get noticed, and their work gets used. For example, one of the most popular data sets on multidisc 第7 页共10 页 iplinary repository Dryad is about wood density around the world; it has been downloaded 5,700 times. Co-author A my Zanne thinks that users probably range from climate-change researchers wanting to estimate how much carbon i s stored in biomass, to foresters looking for information on different grades of timber. "I'd much prefer to have my d ata used by the maximum number of people to ask their own questions," she says. "It's important to allow readers a nd reviewers to see exactly how you arrive at your results. Publishing data and code allows your science to be repro ducible."
paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管共享数据的呼声通常集中在共享的道德优势上，但这种做法并不纯粹是利他的。分享的研究人员可以获得很多个人利益，包括与同事的更多联系、提高的知名度和增加的引用。最成功的共享者——那些数据被下载和引用最频繁的人——会受到关注，他们的作品也会被使用。例如，多学科存储库 Dryad 上最受欢迎的数据集之一是关于世界各地木材密度的；已被下载 5,700 次。合著者 A my Zanne 认为，用户范围可能包括想要估计生物质中储存了多少碳的气候变化研究人员，以及寻找不同等级木材信息的林业工作者。 “我更希望让尽可能多的人使用我的数据来提出自己的问题，”她说。 “重要的是要让读者和审稿人准确地看到你是如何得出结果的。发布数据和代码可以让你的科学具有可重复性。”

paragraphs.sourceText: Even people whose data are less popular can benefit. By making the effort to organize and label files so others c an understand them, scientists become more organized and better disciplined themselves, thus avoiding confusion lat er on.
paragraphs.translationZh: 即使数据不太受欢迎的人也能受益。通过努力组织和标记文件以便其他人能够理解它们，科学家们自己变得更有组织性和更好的纪律性，从而避免了以后的混乱。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 问题 51 至 55 基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Macy's reported its sales plunged 5.2% in November and December at stores open more than a year, a disappoin ting holiday season performance that capped a difficult year for a department store chain facing wide-ranging challen ges. Its flagship stores in major U.S. cities depend heavily on international tourist spending, which shrank at many re tailers due to a strong dollar. Meanwhile, Macy's has simply struggled to lure consumers who are more interested in spending on travel or dining out than on new clothes or accessories.
paragraphs.translationZh: 梅西百货 (Macy's) 报告称，其开业一年多的商店 11 月和 12 月销售额暴跌 5.2%，这一令人失望的假日季业绩为这家面临广泛挑战的百货连锁店艰难的一年画上句号。其在美国主要城市的旗舰店严重依赖国际游客消费，由于美元走强，许多零售商的国际游客消费出现萎缩。与此同时，梅西百货一直在努力吸引那些更热衷于旅行或外出就餐而不是购买新衣服或配饰的消费者。

paragraphs.sourceText: The company blamed much of the poor performance in November and December on unseasonably warm weath er. "About 80% of our company's year-over-year declines incomparable sales can be attributed to shortfalls (短缺) i n cold-weather goods," said chief executive Terry Lundgren in a press release. This prompted the company to cut it s forecasts for the full fourth quarter.
paragraphs.translationZh: 该公司将 11 月和 12 月业绩不佳归咎于反常的温暖天气。首席执行官特里·伦德格伦 (Terry Lundgren) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“我们公司销售额同比大幅下降的大约 80% 可归因于寒冷天气商品的短缺。”这促使该公司下调了整个第四季度的预测。

paragraphs.sourceText: However, it's clear that Macy's believes its troubles run deeper than a temporary aberration (偏离) off the thermo meter. The retail giant said the poor financial performance this year has pushed it to begin implementing $400 millio n in cost-cutting measures. The company pledged to cut 600 back-office positions, though some 150 workers in thos 第8 页共10 页 e roles would be reassigned to other jobs. It also plans to offer "voluntary separation" packages to 165 senior executi ves. It will slash staffing at its fleet of 770 stores, a move affecting some 3,000 employees.
paragraphs.translationZh: 然而，很明显，梅西百货认为它的麻烦不仅仅是温度计的暂时偏差。这家零售巨头表示，今年糟糕的财务表现迫使其开始实施 4 亿美元的成本削减措施。该公司承诺削减 600 个后台职位，不过这些职位的约 150 名员工将被重新分配到其他岗位。它还计划向 165 名高级管理人员提供“自愿离职”方案。该公司将削减其 770 家门店的员工人数，此举影响到约 3,000 名员工。

paragraphs.sourceText: The retailer also announced the locations of 36 stores it will close in early 2016. The company had previously a nnounced the planned closures, but had not said which locations would be affected. None of the chain's stores in th e Washington metropolitan area are to be closed.
paragraphs.translationZh: 该零售商还宣布了将于 2016 年初关闭的 36 家商店的位置。该公司此前曾宣布计划关闭，但没有透露哪些地点将受到影响。该连锁店在华盛顿都市区的所有商店都不会关闭。

paragraphs.sourceText: Macy's has been moving aggressively to try to remake itself for a new era of shopping. It has plans to open mor e locations of Macy's Backstage, a newly-developed off-price concept which might help it better compete with ambit ious T. J. Maxx. It's also pushing ahead in 2016 with an expansion of Bluemercury, the beauty chain it bought last ye ar. At a time when young beauty shoppers are often turning to Sephora or Ulta instead of department store beauty co unters, Macy's hopes Bluemercury will help strengthen its position in the category.
paragraphs.translationZh: 梅西百货一直在积极采取行动，试图重塑自己，以适应新的购物时代。它计划开设更多 Macy's Backstage 门店，这是一个新开发的折扣概念，可能有助于它更好地与雄心勃勃的 T. J. Maxx 竞争。 2016 年，该公司还推进了去年收购的美容连锁店 Bluemercury 的扩张。当年轻的美容品购物者经常转向丝芙兰或 Ulta 而不是百货公司美容柜台时，梅西百货公司希望 Bluemercury 能够帮助巩固其在该类别中的地位。

paragraphs.sourceText: One relative bright spot for Macy's during the holiday season was the online channel, where it rang up "double-digit" increases in sales and a 25% increase in the number of orders it filled. That relative strength would be consisten t with what was seen in the wilder retail industry during the early part of the holiday season. While Thanksgiving, Bl ack Friday and Cyber Monday all saw record spending online, in-store sales plunged over the holiday weekend.
paragraphs.translationZh: 梅西百货在假期期间的一个相对亮点是在线渠道，其销售额实现了“两位数”增长，订单数量增长了 25%。这种相对强度与假日季节初期零售业的狂野情况相符。虽然感恩节、黑色星期五和网络星期一的网上消费都创历史新高，但假日周末店内销售额却大幅下降。
